item.title: OCP 2026: Cooler Master Scales Liquid Cooling from Cold Plates to 2.5 MW CDUs
item.description: An inside look at Cooler Master's expanding AI cooling portfolio reveals a focus on modular design, serviceability, and the equipment needed to deploy liquid cooling at data center scale.
item.author: Matt Vincent
item.media:description: The Cooler Master 300 kW AALC (Air-Assisted Liquid Cooling) CDU offers high-heat-load management for IT hardware, dissipating up to 300 kW of thermal energy. This liquid-to-air CDU is designed for deployment in existing data centers without built-in liquid cooling infrastructure.
